bound.walk: copy printed untemplated GET paths from the official MET Offshoremaps swagger; skip templated {format} paths and GET operations that print required query parameters; native ids are the last printed path segment; access_path is swagger origin + printed basePath + path; do not invent dataset ids or area/time filters
bound.how: pda ingest --source offshoremaps --limit 10. The official MET Offshoremaps swagger prints 5 untemplated GET paths that have a last-segment id and no required query parameter. The adapter copies those paths. GET uses the printed /features collection with no invented query filters. The root path and /helicopterlightningobservations /helicoptersignificantwaveheight /helicoptertriggeredlightningindex print required area so they stay unused for fetch. /available prints XML so it stays unused for fetch.
